name: create_section
description: Add one section to working canvas source. On a page canvas, this appends the section at the end. On a blank reusable canvas, this creates its first source and is valid only when the reusable has no source; after bootstrap, use edit_part kind=global_part. This never updates a live page; a human must Publish or Update live in the Manual editor. Returns the created section ID, preview URL, warnings, and NEXT STEP.

parameters.name: page_id
parameters.description: Uncanny Page Builder canvas page ID. Pass this when the user provides a canvas_id or a page_id known to be an Uncanny Page Builder canvas. For ordinary WordPress page URLs or names, resolve the target first; do not assume any page_id is editable. Omit only for the current page canvas. For a blank reusable canvas, pass its explicit ID.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Display name for the section (e.g. 'Hero Section', 'Pricing Table').

parameters.name: html
parameters.description: Section HTML markup. Must have a single root element with a unique class.

parameters.name: css
parameters.description: Scoped CSS for the section. Use canvas-local selectors such as the section root class, child classes, :target, and local state classes. Avoid document-level selectors like body, html, and :root; if submitted, the write is accepted but returns a WARNING because compiled canvas CSS may filter those selectors.

output.description: Plain-text result. A page append returns PAGE_ID, SECTION_ID, POSITION, NAME, SOURCE_GENERATION, PREVIEW, optional WARNING lines, and NEXT STEP. A blank reusable bootstrap returns KIND: global_part, GLOBAL_PART_ID, PART_TYPE, SECTION_ID, POSITION, NAME, SOURCE_GENERATION, PREVIEW as the authenticated working preview, optional WARNING lines, and NEXT STEP.

errors.422: HTML validation failure — single root element required, no forbidden tags/attributes, valid editables and bindings.
errors.404: Page or reusable canvas not found.
errors.403: Page or reusable canvas is not editable by the current user.
errors.409: The working source changed before the write committed. Read current source before retrying.
